description: This is a PHP interface file defining the MessageInterface for HTTP messages, specifying methods for handling HTTP protocol version, headers, and message body. It is part of the PSR-7 standard for HTTP message interfaces.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP protocol version as a string.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP protocol version.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all message header values as an associative array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header exists by case-insensitive name.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values of a specific header as an array.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Retrieves the header values concatenated as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided header set to a specific value.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header value appended.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Gets the message body as a stream.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified message body stream.
